verdict.rationale: Airbyte publishes a pricing page referencing credits, a free trial ($2,000 of usage) and feature tiers (SSO, RBAC, field renaming), but the evidence shows no per-source or volume-based cost calculator that would let a lead estimate the specific cost of adding a new source before connecting it. A community comment also notes the model splits into free vs. paid ('freemium') features, adding uncertainty to cost estimation. missing for 10: a documented rate card or calculator tying source/connector volume to credit consumption, independent corroboration that estimates match actual billed costs.
